# Geospatial Data Science & Environmental Decision-Making

<div class="lead">
We study how climate change, migration, urbanization, and environmental change reshape landscapes and communities. Our research combines spatial modeling, GeoAI, remote sensing, participatory GIS, and visualization to understand these processes and support environmental decision-making.
</div>

<div class="card-grid">
<div class="topic-card"><h3>Climate adaptation, migration & urban change</h3><p>How will climate-related migration reshape cities, land use, infrastructure, environmental quality, and inequality?</p><span class="tag">climate adaptation</span><span class="tag">migration</span><span class="tag">urban futures</span></div>
<div class="topic-card"><h3>Geospatial AI & spatial data science</h3><p>How can AI and large spatial datasets produce meaningful, scalable, and responsible information about environmental and urban conditions?</p><span class="tag">GeoAI</span><span class="tag">computer vision</span><span class="tag">remote sensing</span></div>

<div class="section-kicker" style="margin-top:3rem;">Selected research</div>

## Current programs and platforms

**GLISA — Great Lakes climate adaptation.** Research and engagement connecting climate science with communities and decision-makers across the Great Lakes.

**CLARS — Climate migration across lake regions.** Comparative research on climate-related migration, urban change, and knowledge exchange in the Lake Victoria Basin and North American Great Lakes.

**PIVOT / CHIRRP / PUMP-COR.** Participatory mapping, flood resilience, and scenario-planning tools that link community knowledge with environmental models.
